Onondaga Physical Therapy is a privately-owned Physical Therapy Practice with 5 locations in Central New York that has been inspiring our customers, community, and team to live, work and play better since 2003. Sharing our expertise to help our larger community improve their quality of life is only one way that we live our mission. Follow us on other platforms for even more tips and inspiration. 

www.onondagapt.com
www.facebook.com/onondagapt
Twitter: @onondagapt
Instagram: @onondaga.pt
